name: Sports & Exercise Talk
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on sports & exercise talk — practice these key phrases out loud:
I try to go for a run three times a week.
Did you watch the match last night?
I'm training for a half-marathon this spring.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
